描述_EN: a 'kendi' is a spouted drinking vessel popular in south-east asia. they held the water through which the smoke was drawn to cool it. in the 16th century, kendis made in china for the south-east asian market were also exported to europe and the middle east. there they found new uses. in iran they were used as the bases of water pipes, also known as 'kalians'.
描述_ZN: "Kendi "是一种流行于东南亚的有嘴的饮水容器。 它们装着水，通过这些水抽出烟来冷却它。 在16世纪，中国为东南亚市场制造的Kendis也被出口到欧洲和中东。 在那里他们找到了新的用途。 在伊朗，它们被用作水管的基座，也被称为 "Kalians"。
